name: Hierarchical Volume Sampling for UDFs
definition: Upsampling $N_2$ new points based on original points $\{q_n\}_{n=1}^{N_1}$ by sampling from a posterior probability distribution defined by sampling density $\tau_n$ and interval $\delta_n$, mitigating bias in non-intersection regions.
summary: Hierarchical Volume Sampling for UDFs upsamples ray points for volume rendering by mitigating standard importance sampling bias and ensuring uniform distribution through an auxiliary prior and uniform upsampling strategy.
